formula: X = Interval_buget == 0 ? 1 : Interval_buget; Rol == 'Membru' ? X : X * 2

X = Nivel == 'International' ? 4 : Nivel == 'National' ? 2 : 1;
(Rol == 'Lider' && N_membri >= 5) ? X * N_ani : 0

name: FEEA_Grant_Any
formula: funder = proj_funder != null ? proj_funder.toUpperCase() : ""; excluded = funder.contains("POS-DRU") || funder.contains("POS-CCE") || funder.contains("POS-CEE") || funder.contains("POCU") || funder.contains("SIPOCA") || funder.contains("POCA") || funder.contains("POC") || funder.contains("ERASMUS"); excluded ? 0 : 1

name: FEEA_Grant_Director
formula: funder = proj_funder != null ? proj_funder.toUpperCase() : ""; excluded = funder.contains("POS-DRU") || funder.contains("POS-CCE") || funder.contains("POS-CEE") || funder.contains("POCU") || funder.contains("SIPOCA") || funder.contains("POCA") || funder.contains("POC") || funder.contains("ERASMUS"); (!excluded && Rol != "Membru") ? 1 : 0
